one.title: What is a group?
one.body: A named list of contacts. A contact can be in several groups, and removing a group never deletes its contacts.

two.title: How should I use groups?
two.body: Create groups for segments like VIPs, new signups, cart abandoners, or local audiences before sending campaigns.

three.title: What happens when I delete one?
three.body: The group disappears from every contact that was in it. Other groups and the contacts themselves stay as they are.

attributes.title: Template attributes
attributes.subtitle: Variables you can drop into any message body. Each one fills in from the contact when the message is sent.

how.title: How attributes work
how.body: Type / in any message body to open the picker. Picking an attribute inserts its token, which is replaced by the contact's value (or the default) when the message is sent.

token.text: Inserted by its key, e.g. order_id

attributes.empty: Create attributes to store reusable customer fields.
attributes.emptyFiltered: No attributes match the current filters. Create attributes to store reusable customer fields.

when.title: When to add one
when.body: If a value is not already on the contact (like an order ID, coupon code, or appointment time), add it as an attribute so templates can fill it in.

rules.title: Keys are permanent
rules.body: A key is used in your templates and flows, so it cannot be changed once created. The display name and default can be edited any time.

naming.title: Naming tips
naming.body: Use snake_case for keys and keep names short and consistent: order_id, tracking_url, discount_code, appointment_at.

tip.title: Default values save you
tip.body: Set a default for every attribute. If a contact is missing that value at send time, the default is used instead of the message failing or showing a blank slot.
